nodes.text: Still watching? Grib is being good. Grib counts carts and touches nothing. One day you will see Grib is no camp goblin.
You... mean it? Then Grib has a friend after all! Grib will remember this day. Grib remembers everything good — there is not so much of it, so it fits.
Grib stays out of everything. Trouble, camps, the baker's window. Mostly the baker's window.
